text: 沃什鹰派发言提振加息预期，美股期指下跌，美国10年期国债收益率升至2025年1月以来最高水平。 日元再破160，贝森特发声：日元“已得到控制”，日本央行“将做正确的事”，“安倍经济学”已走到尽头。 印度二季度GDP增长7.8%超预期：制造业与投资强劲，信贷增速创十年来新高。 英伟达将向联发科投资35亿美元 强化AI硬件产业链核心地位。 韩日芯片合作升温，SK海力士研究在日本合资建存储芯片厂。 为降低HBM成本，SK海力士被曝评估英特尔代工方案。 华为上半年营收同比增10%至4678亿，归母净利234亿，研发投入超1200亿。 云端商业化提速，智谱上半年营
text_en: Warsh's hawkish remarks boost rate hike expectations, US stock futures fall, US 10-year Treasury yield rises to highest since January 2025. Yen breaks 160 again, Bessent says: Yen is 'under control,' BOJ 'will do the right thing,' 'Abenomics' has come to an end. India Q2 GDP grows 7.8% beating expectations: manufacturing and investment strong, credit growth hits decade high. Nvidia to invest $3.5 billion in MediaTek to strengthen core position in AI hardware supply chain. Korea-Japan chip cooperation heats up, SK Hynix studies building a memory chip plant in Japan via joint venture. To lower HBM costs, SK Hynix reportedly evaluates Intel's foundry solution. Huawei H1 revenue up 10% YoY to 467.8 billion yuan, net profit attributable to parent 23.4 billion, R&D investment over 120 billion. Cloud commercialization accelerates, Zhipu H1 operating
